final_thesis.mechanism: PPO's policy gradient with gamma=0.99 and gae_lambda=0.95 underweights mastery benefits that peak at 20-30 steps. Comfort actions earn similar/higher immediate Q_hat relative to V(s), so updates reinforce difficulty-downregulating behavior. DQN bootstraps multi-step value and executes scaffold-harder chains that maintain positive mismatch.
